CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.initialize_fee_month(p_payment_month text)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_inserted INTEGER;
BEGIN

    IF p_payment_month !~
       '^(Jan|Feb|Mar|Apr|May|Jun|Jul|Aug|Sept|Oct|Nov|Dec)-[0-9]{4}$'
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
        'Invalid payment month: %',
        p_payment_month;
    END IF;


    INSERT INTO public.fee_payments
    (
        student_id,
        batch_id,
        amount_paid,
        status,
        payment_month
    )
    SELECT
        id,
        batch_id,
        0,
        'unpaid',
        p_payment_month
    FROM public.students

    ON CONFLICT (student_id, payment_month)
    DO NOTHING;


    GET DIAGNOSTICS v_inserted = ROW_COUNT;

    RETURN v_inserted;

END;
$function$

functions.name: validate_student_subject_stream
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_student_subject_stream()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_class_level SMALLINT;

    v_invalid_count INTEGER;

    v_distinct_count INTEGER;

    v_max_subjects INTEGER;

    v_has_comp BOOLEAN;

    v_has_bio BOOLEAN;
BEGIN

    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    -- BATCH / CLASS
    -- --------------------------------------------------------

    SELECT b.class_level
    INTO v_class_level
    FROM public.batches b
    WHERE b.id = NEW.batch_id;


    IF v_class_level IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Selected batch has no valid class level.';
    END IF;


    IF v_class_level NOT IN (9, 10, 11, 12) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Only Classes 9 to 12 are supported.';
    END IF;


    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    -- AT LEAST ONE SUBJECT
    -- --------------------------------------------------------

    IF NEW.stream IS NULL
       OR cardinality(NEW.stream) < 1
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'At least one subject must be selected for %.',
            NEW.name;
    END IF;


    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    -- ALLOWED SUBJECT CODES ONLY
    -- --------------------------------------------------------

    SELECT
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE u.subject_code NOT IN (
                'Phy',
                'Chem',
                'Math',
                'Eng',
                'Comp',
                'Bio'
            )
        ),
        COUNT(DISTINCT u.subject_code)

    INTO
        v_invalid_count,
        v_distinct_count

    FROM unnest(NEW.stream)
        AS u(subject_code);


    IF v_invalid_count > 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Invalid subject code detected for %.',
            NEW.name;
    END IF;


    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    -- NO DUPLICATE SUBJECTS
    -- --------------------------------------------------------

    IF v_distinct_count <> cardinality(NEW.stream) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Duplicate subjects are not allowed for %.',
            NEW.name;
    END IF;


    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    -- CLASS LIMITS
    -- --------------------------------------------------------

    IF v_class_level IN (9, 10) THEN

        v_max_subjects := 5;

        v_has_comp :=
            'Comp' = ANY(NEW.stream);

        v_has_bio :=
            'Bio' = ANY(NEW.stream);


        -- SSC still treats Computer / Biology as alternatives.
        IF v_has_comp AND v_has_bio THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION
                'Classes 9/10 cannot have both Computer and Biology.';
        END IF;

    ELSE

        -- HSSC is intentionally flexible.
        -- Any combination of allowed subjects is permitted,
        -- but maximum 4 subjects.
        v_max_subjects := 4;

    END IF;


    IF cardinality(NEW.stream) > v_max_subjects THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Class % students can have maximum % subjects.',
            v_class_level,
            v_max_subjects;
    END IF;


    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    -- NORMALIZE ARRAY ORDER
    --
    -- Deterministic ordering helps Flutter, reports and audits.
    -- --------------------------------------------------------

    SELECT array_agg(
        u.subject_code
        ORDER BY
            CASE u.subject_code
                WHEN 'Phy'  THEN 1
                WHEN 'Chem' THEN 2
                WHEN 'Math' THEN 3
                WHEN 'Eng'  THEN 4
                WHEN 'Comp' THEN 5
                WHEN 'Bio'  THEN 6
                ELSE 99
            END
    )

    INTO NEW.stream

    FROM unnest(NEW.stream)
        AS u(subject_code);


    RETURN NEW;

END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_fee_payment_status(p_student_id uuid, p_payment_month text, p_status text, p_amount_paid numeric)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_batch_id UUID;
    v_payment_id UUID;

    v_status TEXT :=
        lower(trim(COALESCE(p_status, '')));

    v_amount NUMERIC :=
        COALESCE(p_amount_paid, 0);

BEGIN

    IF p_payment_month !~
       '^(Jan|Feb|Mar|Apr|May|Jun|Jul|Aug|Sept|Oct|Nov|Dec)-[0-9]{4}$'
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
        'Invalid payment month: %',
        p_payment_month;
    END IF;


    IF v_status NOT IN ('paid', 'unpaid') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
        'Invalid fee status: %',
        v_status;
    END IF;


    SELECT batch_id
    INTO v_batch_id
    FROM public.students
    WHERE id = p_student_id;


    IF v_batch_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
        'Student not found: %',
        p_student_id;
    END IF;


    IF v_status = 'paid' THEN

        IF v_amount <= 0 THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Paid fee amount must be greater than zero';
        END IF;

    ELSE
        v_amount := 0;
    END IF;


    INSERT INTO public.fee_payments
    (
        student_id,
        batch_id,
        amount_paid,
        status,
        payment_month
    )
    VALUES
    (
        p_student_id,
        v_batch_id,
        v_amount,
        v_status,
        p_payment_month
    )

    ON CONFLICT (student_id, payment_month)

    DO UPDATE SET
        batch_id = EXCLUDED.batch_id,
        amount_paid = EXCLUDED.amount_paid,
        status = EXCLUDED.status

    RETURNING id
    INTO v_payment_id;


    RETURN v_payment_id;

END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fee_report_class_code(p_class_level smallint, p_batch_name text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$

SELECT

CASE

    WHEN p_class_level = 9
         AND lower(p_batch_name) LIKE '%girl%'
        THEN '9G'

    WHEN p_class_level = 9
        THEN '9B'

    WHEN p_class_level = 10
         AND lower(p_batch_name) LIKE '%girl%'
        THEN '10G'

    WHEN p_class_level = 10
        THEN '10B'

    WHEN p_class_level = 11
         AND lower(p_batch_name) LIKE '%girl%'
        THEN 'XIG'

    WHEN p_class_level = 11
        THEN 'XIB'

    WHEN p_class_level = 12
         AND lower(p_batch_name) LIKE '%girl%'
        THEN 'XIIG'

    WHEN p_class_level = 12
        THEN 'XIIB'

    ELSE
        'OTHER'

END;

$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fee_report_group_label(p_class_level smallint, p_stream text[])
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$

SELECT
CASE

    -- ========================================================
    -- SSC STANDARD COMPUTER
    -- ========================================================

    WHEN p_class_level IN (9, 10)

    AND cardinality(p_stream) = 5

    AND p_stream @>
        ARRAY[
            'Phy',
            'Chem',
            'Math',
            'Eng',
            'Comp'
        ]::TEXT[]

    THEN 'Computer'


    -- ========================================================
    -- SSC STANDARD BIOLOGY
    -- ========================================================

    WHEN p_class_level IN (9, 10)

    AND cardinality(p_stream) = 5

    AND p_stream @>
        ARRAY[
            'Phy',
            'Chem',
            'Math',
            'Eng',
            'Bio'
        ]::TEXT[]

    THEN 'Biology'


    -- ========================================================
    -- HSSC SINGLE SUBJECT
    -- ========================================================

    WHEN p_class_level IN (11, 12)

    AND cardinality(p_stream) = 1

    THEN
        'Single Subject '
        ||
        p_stream[1]


    -- ========================================================
    -- HSSC FCS
    -- ========================================================

    WHEN p_class_level IN (11, 12)

    AND cardinality(p_stream) = 4

    AND p_stream @>
        ARRAY[
            'Phy',
            'Math',
            'Eng',
            'Comp'
        ]::TEXT[]

    THEN 'FCS'


    -- ========================================================
    -- HSSC PRE-ENGINEERING
    -- ========================================================

    WHEN p_class_level IN (11, 12)

    AND cardinality(p_stream) = 4

    AND p_stream @>
        ARRAY[
            'Phy',
            'Chem',
            'Math',
            'Eng'
        ]::TEXT[]

    THEN 'Pre-Eng'


    -- ========================================================
    -- HSSC PRE-MEDICAL
    -- ========================================================

    WHEN p_class_level IN (11, 12)

    AND cardinality(p_stream) = 4

    AND p_stream @>
        ARRAY[
            'Phy',
            'Chem',
            'Eng',
            'Bio'
        ]::TEXT[]

    THEN 'Pre-Med'


    ELSE
        'Partial / Custom'

END;

$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.provision_portal_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_seed private.portal_account_seed%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN

    IF NEW.email IS NULL THEN
        RETURN NEW;
    END IF;


    SELECT *
    INTO v_seed
    FROM private.portal_account_seed
    WHERE LOWER(email) = LOWER(NEW.email)
    LIMIT 1;


    -- Agar email hamari academy list mein nahi
    -- to portal profile mat banao.
    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RETURN NEW;
    END IF;


    INSERT INTO public.user_profiles (
        user_id,
        email,
        full_name,
        role,
        must_change_password,
        is_active
    )
    VALUES (
        NEW.id,
        LOWER(NEW.email),
        v_seed.full_name,
        v_seed.role,
        FALSE,
        TRUE
    )
    ON CONFLICT (user_id)
    DO UPDATE SET
        email = EXCLUDED.email,
        full_name = EXCLUDED.full_name,
        role = EXCLUDED.role,
        must_change_password = FALSE,
        is_active = TRUE;


    -- Assignment dobara cleanly generate karo.
    DELETE FROM public.teacher_assignments
    WHERE teacher_id = NEW.id;


    IF v_seed.role = 'teacher'
       AND v_seed.class_levels IS NOT NULL
       AND v_seed.subject_code IS NOT NULL
    THEN

        INSERT INTO public.teacher_assignments (
            teacher_id,
            class_level,
            subject_code
        )
        SELECT
            NEW.id,
            level_value,
            v_seed.subject_code
        FROM unnest(v_seed.class_levels)
            AS level_value;

    END IF;


    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.complete_initial_password_change()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN

    IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Authentication required'
            USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;


    UPDATE public.user_profiles
    SET
        must_change_password = FALSE,
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE user_id = auth.uid();


    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Portal profile not found'
            USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;

END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.add_fee_student(p_name text, p_batch_id uuid, p_default_fee numeric, p_stream text[], p_payment_month text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_student_id UUID;

    v_student_name TEXT :=
        trim(
            COALESCE(
                p_name,
                ''
            )
        );

    v_attendance_date DATE :=
        (
            now()
            AT TIME ZONE
            'Asia/Karachi'
        )::DATE;
BEGIN

    IF v_student_name = '' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Student name is required.';
    END IF;


    IF p_default_fee IS NULL
       OR p_default_fee <= 0
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Default fee must be greater than zero.';
    END IF;


    IF p_stream IS NULL
       OR cardinality(p_stream) < 1
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Student subjects are required.';
    END IF;


    IF p_payment_month !~
       '^(Jan|Feb|Mar|Apr|May|Jun|Jul|Aug|Sept|Oct|Nov|Dec)-[0-9]{4}$'
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Invalid payment month: %',
            p_payment_month;
    END IF;


    IF NOT EXISTS (

        SELECT 1

        FROM public.batches

        WHERE id = p_batch_id

    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Selected batch does not exist.';
    END IF;


    IF EXISTS (

        SELECT 1

        FROM public.students

        WHERE batch_id =
            p_batch_id

        AND lower(
            trim(name)
        ) =
        lower(
            v_student_name
        )

    ) THEN

        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'A student named "%" already exists in this batch',
            v_student_name;

    END IF;


    INSERT INTO public.students (
        name,
        batch_id,
        stream,
        status,
        default_fee
    )
    VALUES (
        v_student_name,
        p_batch_id,
        p_stream,
        'enrolled',
        p_default_fee
    )

    RETURNING id
    INTO v_student_id;


    INSERT INTO public.attendance (
        student_id,
        batch_id,
        date,
        status
    )
    VALUES (
        v_student_id,
        p_batch_id,
        v_attendance_date,
        'present'
    )

    ON CONFLICT (
        student_id,
        date
    )

    DO UPDATE SET
        batch_id =
            EXCLUDED.batch_id,

        status =
            'present';


    INSERT INTO public.fee_payments (
        student_id,
        batch_id,
        amount_paid,
        status,
        payment_month,
        subject_stream
    )
    VALUES (
        v_student_id,
        p_batch_id,
        0,
        'unpaid',
        p_payment_month,
        p_stream
    )

    ON CONFLICT (
        student_id,
        payment_month
    )

    DO NOTHING;


    RETURN v_student_id;

END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.request_teacher_access(p_full_name text, p_email text, p_subject_name text, p_class_levels smallint[])
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_id UUID;

    v_name TEXT :=
        btrim(COALESCE(p_full_name, ''));

    v_email TEXT :=
        lower(btrim(COALESCE(p_email, '')));

    v_subject TEXT :=
        btrim(COALESCE(p_subject_name, ''));
BEGIN

    IF char_length(v_name) < 2
       OR char_length(v_name) > 100
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Please enter a valid full name.';
    END IF;


    IF char_length(v_email) < 5
       OR char_length(v_email) > 254
       OR v_email !~
            '^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$'
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Please enter a valid email address.';
    END IF;


    IF char_length(v_subject) < 1
       OR char_length(v_subject) > 80
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Please enter a valid subject.';
    END IF;


    IF p_class_levels IS NULL
       OR cardinality(p_class_levels) = 0
       OR NOT (
           p_class_levels
           <@ ARRAY[9,10,11,12]::SMALLINT[]
       )
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Select at least one valid class.';
    END IF;


    -- Already has a portal account.

    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.user_profiles p
        WHERE lower(p.email) = v_email
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'A portal account already exists for this email.';
    END IF;


    -- Already waiting for approval.

    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.teacher_registration_requests r
        WHERE lower(r.email) = v_email
          AND r.status = 'pending'
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'A registration request for this email is already pending.';
    END IF;


    INSERT INTO public.teacher_registration_requests (
        full_name,
        email,
        subject_name,
        class_levels,
        status
    )
    VALUES (
        v_name,
        v_email,
        v_subject,
        (
            SELECT ARRAY_AGG(
                DISTINCT level_value
                ORDER BY level_value
            )::SMALLINT[]
            FROM unnest(p_class_levels)
                AS level_value
        ),
        'pending'
    )
    RETURNING id
    INTO v_id;


    RETURN v_id;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.service_finalize_teacher_request(p_request_id uuid, p_user_id uuid, p_reviewed_by uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_request
        public.teacher_registration_requests%ROWTYPE;

    v_auth_email TEXT;
BEGIN

    SELECT *
    INTO v_request
    FROM public.teacher_registration_requests
    WHERE id = p_request_id
    FOR UPDATE;


    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Teacher request not found.';
    END IF;


    IF v_request.status <> 'pending' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Teacher request has already been reviewed.';
    END IF;


    -- Reviewer must genuinely be an active admin.

    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.user_profiles p
        WHERE p.user_id = p_reviewed_by
          AND p.role = 'admin'
          AND p.is_active = TRUE
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Valid administrator reviewer required.';
    END IF;


    -- Auth account must already exist.

    SELECT lower(u.email)
    INTO v_auth_email
    FROM auth.users u
    WHERE u.id = p_user_id;


    IF v_auth_email IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Supabase Auth user does not exist.';
    END IF;


    IF v_auth_email <> lower(v_request.email) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Auth email does not match teacher request.';
    END IF;


    -- Create portal profile.

    INSERT INTO public.user_profiles (
        user_id,
        email,
        full_name,
        role,
        must_change_password,
        is_active
    )
    VALUES (
        p_user_id,
        lower(v_request.email),
        v_request.full_name,
        'teacher',
        FALSE,
        TRUE
    )
    ON CONFLICT (user_id)
    DO UPDATE SET
        email = EXCLUDED.email,
        full_name = EXCLUDED.full_name,
        role = 'teacher',
        must_change_password = FALSE,
        is_active = TRUE,
        updated_at = NOW();


    -- Clean assignment generation.

    DELETE FROM public.teacher_assignments
    WHERE teacher_id = p_user_id;


    INSERT INTO public.teacher_assignments (
        teacher_id,
        class_level,
        subject_code
    )
    SELECT
        p_user_id,
        level_value,
        v_request.subject_name
    FROM unnest(
        v_request.class_levels
    ) AS level_value;


    -- Complete request.

    UPDATE public.teacher_registration_requests
    SET
        status = 'approved',
        approved_user_id = p_user_id,
        reviewed_at = NOW(),
        reviewed_by = p_reviewed_by,
        rejection_reason = NULL
    WHERE id = p_request_id;

END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_approve_teacher_request(p_request_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_request
        public.teacher_registration_requests%ROWTYPE;

    v_auth_email TEXT;
BEGIN

    IF NOT public.is_portal_admin() THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Administrator access required'
            USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;


    SELECT *
    INTO v_request
    FROM public.teacher_registration_requests
    WHERE id = p_request_id
    FOR UPDATE;


    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Teacher registration request not found.';
    END IF;


    IF v_request.status <> 'pending' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'This request has already been reviewed.';
    END IF;


    IF v_request.auth_user_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Registration has no linked Auth account.';
    END IF;


    SELECT lower(u.email)
    INTO v_auth_email
    FROM auth.users u
    WHERE u.id = v_request.auth_user_id;


    IF v_auth_email IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Teacher Auth account was not found.';
    END IF;


    IF v_auth_email <> lower(v_request.email) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Registration email does not match Auth account.';
    END IF;


    -- Grant actual portal access.

    INSERT INTO public.user_profiles (
        user_id,
        email,
        full_name,
        role,
        must_change_password,
        is_active
    )
    VALUES (
        v_request.auth_user_id,
        lower(v_request.email),
        v_request.full_name,
        'teacher',
        FALSE,
        TRUE
    )
    ON CONFLICT (user_id)
    DO UPDATE SET
        email = EXCLUDED.email,
        full_name = EXCLUDED.full_name,
        role = 'teacher',
        must_change_password = FALSE,
        is_active = TRUE,
        updated_at = NOW();


    DELETE FROM public.teacher_assignments
    WHERE teacher_id =
        v_request.auth_user_id;


    INSERT INTO public.teacher_assignments (
        teacher_id,
        class_level,
        subject_code
    )
    SELECT
        v_request.auth_user_id,
        level_value,
        v_request.subject_name
    FROM unnest(
        v_request.class_levels
    ) AS level_value;


    UPDATE public.teacher_registration_requests
    SET
        status = 'approved',
        approved_user_id =
            v_request.auth_user_id,
        reviewed_at = NOW(),
        reviewed_by = auth.uid(),
        rejection_reason = NULL
    WHERE id = p_request_id;

END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_update_fee_distribution(p_level_group text, p_teacher_percent numeric, p_nts_percent numeric, p_building_percent numeric, p_admin_percent numeric, p_organizer_percent numeric, p_ecc_percent numeric)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_group TEXT;
    v_total NUMERIC;
BEGIN
    IF NOT public.is_portal_admin() THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Administrator access required'
            USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;

    v_group := UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(p_level_group, '')));

    IF v_group NOT IN ('SSC', 'HSSC') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid fee level group';
    END IF;

    IF p_teacher_percent IS NULL
       OR p_nts_percent IS NULL
       OR p_building_percent IS NULL
       OR p_admin_percent IS NULL
       OR p_organizer_percent IS NULL
       OR p_ecc_percent IS NULL
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'All percentages are required';
    END IF;

    IF p_teacher_percent NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 100
       OR p_nts_percent NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 100
       OR p_building_percent NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 100
       OR p_admin_percent NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 100
       OR p_organizer_percent NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 100
       OR p_ecc_percent NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 100
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Percentages must be between 0 and 100';
    END IF;

    v_total :=
        p_teacher_percent
        + p_nts_percent
        + p_building_percent
        + p_admin_percent
        + p_organizer_percent
        + p_ecc_percent;

    IF ROUND(v_total, 3) <> 100.000 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Distribution percentages must total exactly 100%%. Current total: %%%',
            ROUND(v_total, 3);
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO public.fee_distribution_settings (
        level_group,
        teacher_percent,
        nts_percent,
        building_percent,
        admin_percent,
        organizer_percent,
        ecc_percent,
        updated_at,
        updated_by
    )
    VALUES (
        v_group,
        ROUND(p_teacher_percent, 3),
        ROUND(p_nts_percent, 3),
        ROUND(p_building_percent, 3),
        ROUND(p_admin_percent, 3),
        ROUND(p_organizer_percent, 3),
        ROUND(p_ecc_percent, 3),
        NOW(),
        auth.uid()
    )
    ON CONFLICT (level_group)
    DO UPDATE SET
        teacher_percent = EXCLUDED.teacher_percent,
        nts_percent = EXCLUDED.nts_percent,
        building_percent = EXCLUDED.building_percent,
        admin_percent = EXCLUDED.admin_percent,
        organizer_percent = EXCLUDED.organizer_percent,
        ecc_percent = EXCLUDED.ecc_percent,
        updated_at = NOW(),
        updated_by = auth.uid();
END;
$function$

            USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;

    v_month := TRIM(COALESCE(p_payment_month, ''));
    v_group := UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(p_level_group, '')));

    IF v_month = '' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Payment month is required';
    END IF;

    IF v_group NOT IN ('SSC', 'HSSC') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid level group';
    END IF;

    IF p_teacher_percent IS NULL
       OR p_nts_percent IS NULL
       OR p_building_percent IS NULL
       OR p_admin_percent IS NULL
       OR p_organizer_percent IS NULL
       OR p_ecc_percent IS NULL
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'All percentages are required';
    END IF;

    v_total :=
        p_teacher_percent
        + p_nts_percent
        + p_building_percent
        + p_admin_percent
        + p_organizer_percent
        + p_ecc_percent;

    IF ROUND(v_total, 3) <> 100.000 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Percentages must total exactly 100%%';
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO public.fee_month_distribution_settings (
        payment_month,
        level_group,
        teacher_percent,
        nts_percent,
        building_percent,
        admin_percent,
        organizer_percent,
        ecc_percent,
        updated_at,
        updated_by
    )
    VALUES (
        v_month,
        v_group,
        ROUND(p_teacher_percent, 3),
        ROUND(p_nts_percent, 3),
        ROUND(p_building_percent, 3),
        ROUND(p_admin_percent, 3),
        ROUND(p_organizer_percent, 3),
        ROUND(p_ecc_percent, 3),
        NOW(),
        auth.uid()
    )
    ON CONFLICT (payment_month, level_group)
    DO UPDATE SET
        teacher_percent = EXCLUDED.teacher_percent,
        nts_percent = EXCLUDED.nts_percent,
        building_percent = EXCLUDED.building_percent,
        admin_percent = EXCLUDED.admin_percent,
        organizer_percent = EXCLUDED.organizer_percent,
        ecc_percent = EXCLUDED.ecc_percent,
        updated_at = NOW(),
        updated_by = auth.uid();
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.portal_add_student_from_attendance(p_name text, p_batch_id uuid, p_group_subject text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_class_level SMALLINT;

    v_subjects TEXT[];
BEGIN

    SELECT b.class_level
    INTO v_class_level

    FROM public.batches b

    WHERE b.id = p_batch_id;


    IF v_class_level IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Batch not found.';
    END IF;


    IF v_class_level IN (9, 10) THEN

        CASE p_group_subject

            WHEN 'Comp' THEN
                v_subjects :=
                    ARRAY[
                        'Phy',
                        'Chem',
                        'Math',
                        'Eng',
                        'Comp'
                    ]::TEXT[];

            WHEN 'Bio' THEN
                v_subjects :=
                    ARRAY[
                        'Phy',
                        'Chem',
                        'Math',
                        'Eng',
                        'Bio'
                    ]::TEXT[];

            ELSE
                RAISE EXCEPTION
                    'Classes 9/10 require Computer or Biology.';

        END CASE;


    ELSIF v_class_level IN (11, 12) THEN

        CASE p_group_subject

            -- Pre-Engineering
            WHEN 'Chem' THEN
                v_subjects :=
                    ARRAY[
                        'Phy',
                        'Chem',
                        'Math',
                        'Eng'
                    ]::TEXT[];

            -- FCS
            WHEN 'Comp' THEN
                v_subjects :=
                    ARRAY[
                        'Phy',
                        'Math',
                        'Eng',
                        'Comp'
                    ]::TEXT[];

            -- Pre-Medical
            WHEN 'Bio' THEN
                v_subjects :=
                    ARRAY[
                        'Phy',
                        'Chem',
                        'Eng',
                        'Bio'
                    ]::TEXT[];

            ELSE
                RAISE EXCEPTION
                    'Classes 11/12 require FCS, Pre-Engineering or Pre-Medical.';

        END CASE;


    ELSE

        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Only Classes 9 to 12 are supported.';

    END IF;


    RETURN public.portal_add_student_from_attendance_v2(
        p_name,
        p_batch_id,
        v_subjects
    );

END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.portal_add_student_from_attendance_v2(p_name text, p_batch_id uuid, p_subjects text[])
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_name TEXT;

    v_class_level SMALLINT;

    v_default_fee NUMERIC(12,2);

    v_today DATE;

    v_payment_month TEXT;

    v_student_id UUID;
BEGIN

    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    -- AUTH
    -- --------------------------------------------------------

    IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Authentication required.'
            USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;


    v_name :=
        trim(
            COALESCE(
                p_name,
                ''
            )
        );


    IF v_name = '' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Student name is required.';
    END IF;


    IF p_subjects IS NULL
       OR cardinality(p_subjects) < 1
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'At least one subject must be selected.';
    END IF;


    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    -- BATCH
    -- --------------------------------------------------------

    SELECT b.class_level
    INTO v_class_level

    FROM public.batches b

    WHERE b.id = p_batch_id;


    IF v_class_level IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Batch not found.';
    END IF;


    IF NOT (
        public.is_portal_admin()
        OR public.can_access_batch(
            p_batch_id
        )
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'You are not allowed to add students to this batch.'
            USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;


    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    -- TEACHER-SIDE SAFETY
    --
    -- A teacher adding from Attendance must include at least
    -- one subject that the teacher actually teaches in this
    -- class.
    --
    -- Admin is exempt.
    -- --------------------------------------------------------

    IF NOT public.is_portal_admin() THEN

        IF NOT EXISTS (

            SELECT 1

            FROM public.teacher_assignments ta

            WHERE ta.teacher_id = auth.uid()

            AND ta.class_level = v_class_level

            AND ta.subject_code =
                ANY(p_subjects)

        ) THEN

            RAISE EXCEPTION
                'The student must include your teaching subject.'
                USING ERRCODE = '42501';

        END IF;

    END IF;


    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    -- DUPLICATE STUDENT
    -- --------------------------------------------------------

    IF EXISTS (

        SELECT 1

        FROM public.students s

        WHERE s.batch_id = p_batch_id

        AND lower(
            trim(s.name)
        ) =
        lower(v_name)

    ) THEN

        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'A student with this name already exists in this batch.';

    END IF;


    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    -- DEFAULT FEE
    --
    -- Use most common existing batch fee.
    -- --------------------------------------------------------

    SELECT s.default_fee

    INTO v_default_fee

    FROM public.students s

    WHERE s.batch_id = p_batch_id

    AND s.default_fee IS NOT NULL

    AND s.default_fee > 0

    GROUP BY s.default_fee

    ORDER BY
        COUNT(*) DESC,
        s.default_fee DESC

    LIMIT 1;


    IF v_default_fee IS NULL THEN

        v_default_fee :=
            CASE
                WHEN v_class_level
                     IN (9, 10)
                THEN 5500

                ELSE 6000
            END;

    END IF;


    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    -- CREATE STUDENT
    --
    -- Trigger validates selected subjects.
    -- --------------------------------------------------------

    INSERT INTO public.students (
        name,
        batch_id,
        stream,
        status,
        default_fee
    )
    VALUES (
        v_name,
        p_batch_id,
        p_subjects,
        'enrolled',
        v_default_fee
    )

    RETURNING id
    INTO v_student_id;


    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    -- ACADEMY LOCAL DATE
    -- --------------------------------------------------------

    v_today :=
        (
            CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            AT TIME ZONE
            'Asia/Karachi'
        )::DATE;


    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    -- TODAY ATTENDANCE = PRESENT
    -- --------------------------------------------------------

    INSERT INTO public.attendance (
        student_id,
        batch_id,
        date,
        status
    )
    VALUES (
        v_student_id,
        p_batch_id,
        v_today,
        'present'
    )

    ON CONFLICT (
        student_id,
        date
    )

    DO UPDATE SET
        batch_id =
            EXCLUDED.batch_id,

        status =
            'present';


    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    -- CURRENT MONTH
    -- --------------------------------------------------------

    v_payment_month :=
        CASE

            WHEN EXTRACT(
                MONTH
                FROM v_today
            ) = 9

            THEN
                'Sept-'
                ||
                EXTRACT(
                    YEAR
                    FROM v_today
                )::INTEGER::TEXT

            ELSE
                to_char(
                    v_today,
                    'Mon-YYYY'
                )

        END;


    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    -- CURRENT MONTH FEE = UNPAID
    --
    -- Snapshot subjects immediately.
    -- --------------------------------------------------------

    INSERT INTO public.fee_payments (
        student_id,
        batch_id,
        payment_month,
        status,
        amount_paid,
        subject_stream
    )
    VALUES (
        v_student_id,
        p_batch_id,
        v_payment_month,
        'unpaid',
        0,
        p_subjects
    )

    ON CONFLICT (
        student_id,
        payment_month
    )

    DO NOTHING;


    RETURN v_student_id;

END;
$function$

WITH grouped AS (

            round(sum(fee_financial_reports.amount_paid), 2) AS total_collection,
            round(sum(fee_financial_reports.teacher_share_total), 2) AS teacher_share_total,
            round(sum(fee_financial_reports.nts_fund), 2) AS nts_fund,
            round(sum(fee_financial_reports.building_fund), 2) AS building_fund,
            round(sum(fee_financial_reports.admin_fund), 2) AS admin_fund,
            round(sum(fee_financial_reports.organizer_fund), 2) AS organizer_fund,
            round(sum(fee_financial_reports.ecc_fund), 2) AS ecc_fund,
            round(sum(fee_financial_reports.distribution_total), 2) AS total_distributed
           FROM fee_financial_reports
          GROUP BY fee_financial_reports.payment_month, fee_financial_reports.month_start, fee_financial_reports.level_group
        ), combined AS (
         SELECT grouped.payment_month,
            grouped.month_start,
            grouped.level_group AS group_name,
            grouped.paid_students,
            grouped.unpaid_students,
            grouped.total_collection,
            grouped.teacher_share_total,
            grouped.nts_fund,
            grouped.building_fund,
            grouped.admin_fund,
            grouped.organizer_fund,
            grouped.ecc_fund,
            grouped.total_distributed,
                CASE
                    WHEN grouped.level_group = 'SSC'::text THEN 1
                    ELSE 2
                END AS display_order
           FROM grouped
        UNION ALL
         SELECT grouped.payment_month,
            min(grouped.month_start) AS min,
            'TOTAL'::text AS group_name,
            sum(grouped.paid_students)::integer AS sum,
            sum(grouped.unpaid_students)::integer AS sum,
            round(sum(grouped.total_collection), 2) AS round,
            round(sum(grouped.teacher_share_total), 2) AS round,
            round(sum(grouped.nts_fund), 2) AS round,
            round(sum(grouped.building_fund), 2) AS round,
            round(sum(grouped.admin_fund), 2) AS round,
            round(sum(grouped.organizer_fund), 2) AS round,
            round(sum(grouped.ecc_fund), 2) AS round,
            round(sum(grouped.total_distributed), 2) AS round,
            3
           FROM grouped
          GROUP BY grouped.payment_month
        )
 SELECT payment_month,
    month_start,
    group_name,
    paid_students,
    unpaid_students,
    total_collection,
    teacher_share_total,
    nts_fund,
    building_fund,
    admin_fund,
    organizer_fund,
    ecc_fund,
    total_distributed,
    display_order
   FROM combined;

           FROM fee_financial_reports report

            round(sum(subject_data.payout), 2) AS total_amount
           FROM subject_data
          GROUP BY subject_data.payment_month, subject_data.subject_code
        )
 SELECT aggregated.payment_month,

WITH financial_total AS (
         SELECT summary.payment_month,
            summary.month_start,
            summary.group_name,
            summary.paid_students,
            summary.unpaid_students,
            summary.total_collection,
            summary.teacher_share_total,
            summary.nts_fund,
            summary.building_fund,
            summary.admin_fund,
            summary.organizer_fund,
            summary.ecc_fund,
            summary.total_distributed,
            summary.display_order
           FROM fee_audit_final_summary summary
          WHERE summary.group_name = 'TOTAL'::text
        ), detail AS (
         SELECT total.payment_month,
            allocation.display_order,
            allocation.staff_name,
            allocation.designation,
            allocation.source_type,
                CASE
                    WHEN allocation.source_type = 'admin'::text THEN total.admin_fund
                    WHEN allocation.source_type = 'organizer'::text THEN total.organizer_fund
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS share_payment,
                CASE
                    WHEN allocation.source_type = 'nts'::text THEN COALESCE(override_row.amount, allocation.planned_amount)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS nts_payment,
                CASE
                    WHEN allocation.source_type = 'admin'::text THEN total.admin_fund
                    WHEN allocation.source_type = 'organizer'::text THEN total.organizer_fund
                    WHEN allocation.source_type = 'nts'::text THEN COALESCE(override_row.amount, allocation.planned_amount)
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END AS total_payment,
            allocation.remarks,
            false AS is_total
           FROM financial_total total
             CROSS JOIN fee_staff_allocations allocation
             LEFT JOIN fee_staff_payment_overrides override_row ON override_row.payment_month = total.payment_month AND lower(override_row.staff_name) = lower(allocation.staff_name)
        )
 SELECT detail.payment_month,
    detail.display_order,
    detail.staff_name,
    detail.designation,
    detail.source_type,
    detail.share_payment,
    detail.nts_payment,
    detail.total_payment,
    detail.remarks,
    detail.is_total
   FROM detail
UNION ALL
 SELECT detail.payment_month,
    999 AS display_order,
    'TOTAL'::text AS staff_name,
    ''::text AS designation,
    'total'::text AS source_type,
    round(sum(COALESCE(detail.share_payment, 0::numeric)), 2) AS share_payment,
    round(sum(COALESCE(detail.nts_payment, 0::numeric)), 2) AS nts_payment,
    round(sum(detail.total_payment), 2) AS total_payment,
    NULL::text AS remarks,
    true AS is_total
   FROM detail
  GROUP BY detail.payment_month;

WITH report_data AS (

view_definitions.name: fee_summary_totals
view_definitions.definition:
WITH base AS (
         SELECT fee_financial_reports.payment_id,
            fee_financial_reports.payment_month,
            fee_financial_reports.month_start,
            fee_financial_reports.student_id,
            fee_financial_reports.student_name,
            fee_financial_reports.batch_id,
            fee_financial_reports.batch_name,
            fee_financial_reports.class_level,
            fee_financial_reports.level_group,
            fee_financial_reports.stream,
            fee_financial_reports.subject_count,
            fee_financial_reports.default_fee,
            fee_financial_reports.amount_paid,
            fee_financial_reports.status,
            fee_financial_reports.teacher_rate,
            fee_financial_reports.teacher_share_total,
            fee_financial_reports.teacher_share_per_subject,
            fee_financial_reports.nts_fund,
            fee_financial_reports.building_fund,
            fee_financial_reports.admin_fund,
            fee_financial_reports.organizer_fund,
            fee_financial_reports.ecc_fund,
            fee_financial_reports.non_teacher_funds_total,
            fee_financial_reports.distribution_total,
            fee_financial_reports.created_at,
            fee_financial_reports.updated_at
           FROM fee_financial_reports
        ), teacher_subjects AS (
         SELECT report.payment_month,
            report.month_start,
            report.level_group,
            subject_name.subject_name,
                CASE
                    WHEN report.status = 'paid'::text THEN report.teacher_share_per_subject
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END AS payout_amount,
                CASE
                    WHEN report.status = 'paid'::text THEN report.student_id
                    ELSE NULL::uuid
                END AS paid_student_id
           FROM base report
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(report.stream) subject_name(subject_name)
        ), collection_rows AS (
         SELECT base.payment_month,
            base.month_start,
            'collection'::text AS section,
            'ALL'::text AS group_name,
            'Total Collection'::text AS item_name,
            round(COALESCE(sum(base.amount_paid), 0::numeric), 2) AS amount,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE base.status = 'paid'::text) AS paid_students,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE base.status = 'unpaid'::text) AS unpaid_students,
            10 AS sort_order
           FROM base
          GROUP BY base.payment_month, base.month_start
        UNION ALL
         SELECT base.payment_month,
            base.month_start,
            'collection'::text,
            base.level_group,
            base.level_group || ' Collection'::text,
            round(COALESCE(sum(base.amount_paid), 0::numeric), 2) AS round,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE base.status = 'paid'::text) AS count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE base.status = 'unpaid'::text) AS count,
                CASE
                    WHEN base.level_group = 'SSC'::text THEN 20
                    ELSE 30
                END AS "case"
           FROM base
          GROUP BY base.payment_month, base.month_start, base.level_group
        ), teacher_total_rows AS (
         SELECT base.payment_month,
            base.month_start,
            'teacher'::text AS section,
            base.level_group AS group_name,
            'Total Teacher Share'::text AS item_name,
            round(COALESCE(sum(base.teacher_share_total), 0::numeric), 2) AS amount,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE base.status = 'paid'::text) AS paid_students,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE base.status = 'unpaid'::text) AS unpaid_students,
                CASE
                    WHEN base.level_group = 'SSC'::text THEN 100
                    ELSE 200
                END AS sort_order
           FROM base
          GROUP BY base.payment_month, base.month_start, base.level_group
        ), teacher_subject_rows AS (
         SELECT teacher_subjects.payment_month,
            teacher_subjects.month_start,
            'teacher'::text AS section,
            teacher_subjects.level_group AS group_name,
            teacher_subjects.subject_name AS item_name,
            round(COALESCE(sum(teacher_subjects.payout_amount), 0::numeric), 2) AS amount,
            count(teacher_subjects.paid_student_id) AS paid_students,
            0::bigint AS unpaid_students,
                CASE teacher_subjects.level_group
                    WHEN 'SSC'::text THEN
                    CASE teacher_subjects.subject_name
                        WHEN 'Phy'::text THEN 111
                        WHEN 'Chem'::text THEN 112
                        WHEN 'Math'::text THEN 113
                        WHEN 'Eng'::text THEN 114
                        WHEN 'Comp'::text THEN 115
                        WHEN 'Bio'::text THEN 116
                        ELSE 119
                    END
                    ELSE
                    CASE teacher_subjects.subject_name
                        WHEN 'Phy'::text THEN 211
                        WHEN 'Math'::text THEN 212
                        WHEN 'Eng'::text THEN 213
                        WHEN 'Chem'::text THEN 214
                        WHEN 'Bio'::text THEN 215
                        WHEN 'Comp'::text THEN 216
                        ELSE 219
                    END
                END AS sort_order
           FROM teacher_subjects
          GROUP BY teacher_subjects.payment_month, teacher_subjects.month_start, teacher_subjects.level_group, teacher_subjects.subject_name
        ), fund_rows AS (
         SELECT report.payment_month,
            report.month_start,
            'fund'::text AS section,
            'ALL'::text AS group_name,
            fund.item_name,
            round(COALESCE(sum(fund.amount), 0::numeric), 2) AS amount,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE report.status = 'paid'::text) AS paid_students,
            0::bigint AS unpaid_students,
            fund.sort_order
           FROM base report
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( VALUES ('NTS Fund'::text,report.nts_fund,301), ('Building Fund'::text,report.building_fund,302), ('Admin Fund'::text,report.admin_fund,303), ('Organizer Fund'::text,report.organizer_fund,304), ('ECC Fund'::text,report.ecc_fund,305)) fund(item_name, amount, sort_order)
          GROUP BY report.payment_month, report.month_start, fund.item_name, fund.sort_order
        )
 SELECT collection_rows.payment_month,
    collection_rows.month_start,
    collection_rows.section,
    collection_rows.group_name,
    collection_rows.item_name,
    collection_rows.amount,
    collection_rows.paid_students,
    collection_rows.unpaid_students,
    collection_rows.sort_order
   FROM collection_rows
UNION ALL
 SELECT teacher_total_rows.payment_month,
    teacher_total_rows.month_start,
    teacher_total_rows.section,
    teacher_total_rows.group_name,

UNION ALL
 SELECT teacher_subject_rows.payment_month,

view_definitions.name: fee_audit_ecc_balance
view_definitions.definition:
SELECT total.payment_month,
    COALESCE(setting.report_title, 'Breakdown of Fee Collected for the Month of '::text || total.payment_month) AS report_title,
    COALESCE(setting.previous_ecc_balance, 0::numeric) AS previous_ecc_balance,
    total.ecc_fund AS current_ecc_collection,
    round(COALESCE(setting.previous_ecc_balance, 0::numeric) + total.ecc_fund, 2) AS total_ecc_balance,
    COALESCE(setting.expenses, 0::numeric) AS expenses,
    round(COALESCE(setting.previous_ecc_balance, 0::numeric) + total.ecc_fund - COALESCE(setting.expenses, 0::numeric), 2) AS closing_ecc_balance,
    COALESCE(setting.expenses_label, 'Expenses'::text) AS expenses_label,
    COALESCE(setting.closing_balance_label, 'Closing ECC Balance'::text) AS closing_balance_label,
    COALESCE(setting.sop_remark, ''::text) AS sop_remark,
    COALESCE(setting.approval_note, ''::text) AS approval_note
   FROM fee_audit_final_summary total
     LEFT JOIN fee_audit_month_settings setting ON setting.payment_month = total.payment_month
  WHERE total.group_name = 'TOTAL'::text;

view_definitions.name: fee_financial_reports
view_definitions.definition:
SELECT fp.id AS payment_id,
    fp.payment_month,
    to_date(replace(fp.payment_month, 'Sept-'::text, 'Sep-'::text), 'Mon-YYYY'::text) AS month_start,
    fp.student_id,
    student.name AS student_name,
    fp.batch_id,
    batch.name AS batch_name,
    batch.class_level,
        CASE
            WHEN batch.class_level = ANY (ARRAY[9, 10]) THEN 'SSC'::text
            ELSE 'HSSC'::text
        END AS level_group,
    COALESCE(fp.subject_stream, student.stream) AS stream,
    cardinality(COALESCE(fp.subject_stream, student.stream)) AS subject_count,
    student.default_fee,
    fp.amount_paid,
    fp.status,
    COALESCE(month_setting.teacher_percent, default_setting.teacher_percent) / 100.0 AS teacher_rate,
    fp.amount_paid * (COALESCE(month_setting.teacher_percent, default_setting.teacher_percent) / 100.0) AS teacher_share_total,
    fp.amount_paid * (COALESCE(month_setting.teacher_percent, default_setting.teacher_percent) / 100.0) / NULLIF(cardinality(COALESCE(fp.subject_stream, student.stream)), 0)::numeric AS teacher_share_per_subject,
    fp.amount_paid * (COALESCE(month_setting.nts_percent, default_setting.nts_percent) / 100.0) AS nts_fund,
    fp.amount_paid * (COALESCE(month_setting.building_percent, default_setting.building_percent) / 100.0) AS building_fund,
    fp.amount_paid * (COALESCE(month_setting.admin_percent, default_setting.admin_percent) / 100.0) AS admin_fund,
    fp.amount_paid * (COALESCE(month_setting.organizer_percent, default_setting.organizer_percent) / 100.0) AS organizer_fund,
    fp.amount_paid * (COALESCE(month_setting.ecc_percent, default_setting.ecc_percent) / 100.0) AS ecc_fund,
    fp.amount_paid * ((COALESCE(month_setting.nts_percent, default_setting.nts_percent) + COALESCE(month_setting.building_percent, default_setting.building_percent) + COALESCE(month_setting.admin_percent, default_setting.admin_percent) + COALESCE(month_setting.organizer_percent, default_setting.organizer_percent) + COALESCE(month_setting.ecc_percent, default_setting.ecc_percent)) / 100.0) AS non_teacher_funds_total,
    fp.amount_paid * ((COALESCE(month_setting.teacher_percent, default_setting.teacher_percent) + COALESCE(month_setting.nts_percent, default_setting.nts_percent) + COALESCE(month_setting.building_percent, default_setting.building_percent) + COALESCE(month_setting.admin_percent, default_setting.admin_percent) + COALESCE(month_setting.organizer_percent, default_setting.organizer_percent) + COALESCE(month_setting.ecc_percent, default_setting.ecc_percent)) / 100.0) AS distribution_total,
    fp.created_at,
    fp.updated_at
   FROM fee_payments fp
     JOIN students student ON student.id = fp.student_id
     JOIN batches batch ON batch.id = fp.batch_id
     JOIN fee_distribution_settings default_setting ON default_setting.level_group =
        CASE
            WHEN batch.class_level = ANY (ARRAY[9, 10]) THEN 'SSC'::text
            ELSE 'HSSC'::text
        END
     LEFT JOIN fee_month_distribution_settings month_setting ON month_setting.payment_month = fp.payment_month AND month_setting.level_group = default_setting.level_group;
